correctness.rationale: Exact Fourier fiberization over the fractional coordinate gives two 2×2 Hermitian Gram matrices with eigenvalues 2±2|cos(pi n tau)|. Positive measure for both fibers yields sharp essential spectral extrema, and pointwise inversion gives completeness. The nearest-half-integer minimax inequality gives unique shifts ±1/(2m+1). Integer separation yields a single tight fiber. Deterministic independent finite-integral tests passed 14808 checks; analytical proof establishes all universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: The sharp optimal two-coset Riesz bound ratio and unique optimal offsets quantify stable reconstruction of a non-spectral pair of unit intervals. Their independence from fractional gap and discontinuity at integer displacement is a motivated boundary phenomenon not supplied by qualitative existence or orthogonality statements. The exact family-level optimum has direct conditioning meaning without claiming global best frequency sets.
